title: “Where is this coming from?” Uncovering Trustworthiness Ideals in AI-powered Peripartum Information Seeking

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative focus groups discussing obstetric racism, historical medical mistrust, and the need for AI systems to be mistrust-aware regarding treatment of Black and Brown patients.
Focus group discussions evaluating how AI tools should account for social determinants of health and inequities in care access based on income and education.
Evaluating stakeholder expectations for AI to navigate structural disparities in reproductive health information and care linked to religious identity.
Analysis of the requirement for AI systems to support pluralistic verification practices that respect culturally variable health guidance.
Identifying stakeholder needs for AI-powered health tools to provide support across multiple languages and improve accessibility for non-English speakers.
